description: ccvi-data publishes the processing pipeline for a gridded Climate–Conflict–Vulnerability Index. Its README identifies a collaboration of the University of the Bundeswehr Munich, Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research and the German Federal Foreign Office, with climate, conflict and vulnerability indicator modules. Users provide the documented source indicators and configuration; outputs are index layers updated quarterly at about half-degree grid spacing. Geographic coverage is global at that coarse resolution. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the code; original indicators may have separate terms. A limitation is that an index of human-security risk is not a prediction of a particular infrastructure failure or local conflict event. It can inform broad stress-test contexts for energy, water and service access under compound hazards. The related QGIS catalogue platform can inspect its gridded output. No source indicator or index raster was downloaded.
name: CCVI climate-conflict vulnerability processing
